This guide provides a detailed walkthrough of its four core functions — Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage — with practical implementation steps, profile customization guidance, and tool recommendations for organizations at every maturity level. governance 7 sections Last updated : March 28, 2026 Table of Contents Overview of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework The Four Core Functions: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage AI RMF Profiles and Use Cases Relationship to NIST AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile) Implementation Roadmap Tools for AI RMF Compliance Comparison with Other Governance Frameworks Frequently Asked Questions Overview of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), published in January 2023 by the National Institute of Standards and Technology, provides a structured, voluntary approach to managing the risks posed by AI systems throughout their lifecycle.
